integrity: The orbit-to-age argument, the factorial A006455 identity, the linear-extension double count, and the Stirling transform were reconstructed directly. A brute-force verifier independently enumerates naturally labeled posets, all labeled posets and their linear extensions, and equality partitions in small arities.
limitations: The orbit formula is a short synthesis of Fraisse ultrahomogeneity with classical naturally-labeled-poset enumeration, so unindexed folklore priority is plausible. The finite replay is exhaustive only in small arities and the classical poset asymptotic is cited rather than re-proved.
title: Naturally labeled posets are the orbit profile of the universal ordered poset
